data.narrative:
Fervo Energy is a pre-IPO climate and energy company founded by Tim Latimer and Jack Norbeck, having raised over $1.5B to date. The valuation universe consists of 9 peers operating in Climate & Energy, including 1 public company (Linergia, ticker LNZA) and 8 private companies. Notable private comparables include Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

Standard peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here due to insufficient depth within filtered peer cohorts. No same-stage peers, adjacent-stage peers, or similar-valuation-tier peers exist in sufficient quantity (minimum 3 required) to support a robust comparable-company analysis. The broader Climate & Energy sector peer set of 9 companies lacks the narrowness required to establish meaningful multiples without material selection bias.

Given these constraints, triangulation using public market comps and private funding rounds would be the primary paths forward, though neither is presented in the available data. The single public comp (LNZA) provides limited directional guidance on its own. A complete valuation would require either: (1) expansion to adjacent energy or climate-tech subsectors to establish multiples; (2) precedent transaction analysis within the geothermal or advanced energy space; or (3) discounted cash flow analysis with explicit assumption disclosure. Until those methods are applied, no defensible valuation range can be anchored.
